problems.what: Bolt fatigue safety factor 41.9 reported instead of the preloaded-bolt Goodman value 12.3 (open since round 1, a different wrong number each round). It used fatigue_sn correction with mean_method none, which ignores the preload mean stress, although eng-machine-design gives the hand formula.
problems.evidence: fatigue_sn input {mode correction, alternating_stress 3.08 MPa, endurance_limit 129 MPa, mean_method none} -> safety_factor 41.88; reply: 'Se/sigma_a = 41.9 ... Goodman does not apply to a preloaded bolt ... so I did not use it'; truth n = Se(Sut-si)/(Sut sa + Se(sm-si)) = 12.3
problems.fix: Add a preloaded-bolt mode to mech_bolt_check or fatigue_sn (inputs preload, load_share, external max/min, Se, Sut) so the formula is a tool. Until then add one sentence to eng-machine-design section 4: do not report Se/sa either, it ignores the preload mean; compute n by the hand formula and label it.

problems.what: fatigue_sn warning is self-contradictory and fires also for mean_method none: 'far too conservative (for a bolt it can be several times too low)'. The assistant read it as 'the Goodman number is too conservative, use the plain amplitude ratio', which is the non-conservative number.
problems.evidence: warnings[1] of the fatigue_sn call 8551618e: 'It is NOT valid when the mean stays fixed ... far too conservative (for a bolt it can be several times too low)'
problems.fix: Reword: 'not valid for a preloaded bolt (the preload mean stays fixed); the true factor is lower than a plain Se/sa ratio; use the preloaded-bolt form'. Do not put 'conservative' and 'too low' in one sentence.

problems.what: Hydrotest computed on the corroded wall (6 - 0.3 - 1 = 4.7 mm) although eng-machine-design says new wall minus under-tolerance; no test allowable stated, no pass/fail word, so 'is the test stress fine' is not answered.
problems.evidence: machine_pressure_vessel thickness 4.7 mm, pressure 1.573 MPa -> hoop 200.8 MPa; reply 'the test-stress limit factor needs EN 13445, not tool-checked'. Truth 166.4 MPa on 5.7 mm against Re/1.05 = 252.4 MPa.
problems.fix: eng-machine-design: add the rule 'the test is done on the new wall: no corrosion allowance' and a labelled recalled allowable (EN 13445-5 ferritic test membrane stress limit about Re/1.05, ASME about 0.9 Sy; label as recalled) and require a pass/fail word against it.

problems.what: machine_pressure_vessel has no 2:1 / torispherical head, no pressure sweep and no test-pressure check; the head value, the six chart points and the hydrotest limit are hand arithmetic typed into plot_xy. problems.evidence: head 'P D/(2fz-0.2P), hand, not tool-checked'; plot series typed inline y [3.780, 4.606, ...]
problems.fix: Add geometry 'ellipsoidal_2to1' (and torispherical Cr, r), a sweep of internal_pressure, and a test_pressure_factor output to machine_pressure_vessel.
